issues.description: The template declares the Course.ratings property as an (internal) stored var ([Int]) while the solution makes this same property private (private var ratings: [Int]). The problem statement only says "a var called `ratings` that is an array of type `Int`" but does not specify visibility. This cross-artifact visibility difference could confuse students about whether they are expected to access `ratings` directly (template appears to allow it) or keep it encapsulated (solution hides it).
issues.suggested_fix: Make visibility consistent across artifacts. Either (a) mark `ratings` as private in the template (private var ratings: [Int]) and update the problem statement to avoid implying external access to `ratings`, or (b) keep `ratings` non-private in the solution. Prefer (a) to teach encapsulation: update the template to declare `private var ratings: [Int]` and note in the problem statement that ratings should be managed via the provided methods (addRating/getAverageRating).
